metadata.title: Repair | Ballard
metadata.description: Free repair. Any Ballard gear, any age.

props.imageAlt: Repairing Ballard gear at a sewing machine
props.heading:
Free repair. Any
Ballard gear, any age.
props.description: We've repaired gear since 1963 because the fleet wouldn't have bought it otherwise. Turnaround is about two weeks.

steps.title: Tell us what's wrong
steps.description: Start a request below or bring it to any store. Describe the damage in a sentence. A photo helps.

steps.title: Send it or drop it off
steps.description: We email a prepaid label for gear over $150. Under that, you pay shipping one way. Stores take anything.

steps.title: We fix it
steps.description: Seams, zips, snaps, seam tape, reproofing, re-knit cuffs and elbows. About two weeks from the day we get it.

steps.title: It comes back
steps.description: Return shipping is on us. If we can't fix it, we'll tell you why and offer 40% off a replacement.

rows.label: Shells and parkas
rows.value: Seam tape, zips, cuffs, hoods, DWR reproofing

rows.label: Waxed cotton
rows.value: Reproofing, snaps, pocket bags, collar corduroy

rows.label: Bibs and pants
rows.value: Knees, seat, suspenders, leg zips, hems

rightSections.heading: What we don't
paragraphs: Socks, gloves, and boots. Socks and gloves wear through where they're supposed to. Boots are rubber, and a patched rubber boot leaks. When these wear out, they're worn out.
Wrenfield blankets and shirts go back to the mill in Bridgewater. Any Ballard store will send them for you.

rightSections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Repair is free for the life of the gear. Reproofing waxed cotton is $35 because the wax is a consumable. You pay shipping one way on gear under $150.

props.heading: Start a repair
props.description: Fill this in and we'll email a label or a store drop-off slip within one business day.
